title: The Yoga Sutras of Patanjali: A New Edition, Translation, and Commentary

publication.publisher_or_container: North Point Press (Farrar, Straus and Giroux)

access.locator: Publisher record; sutra text and commentary corroborated by reference works on the Yoga Sutras

verification.verification_notes: Yoga Sutras 1.12-1.15 pair abhyasa (practice) and vairagya (dispassion/renunciation) as the means to still the mind; Bryant's translation and survey of commentators confirmed as a standard scholarly edition.

limitations: Sanskrit technical terms (vairagya, abhyasa, citta-vritti) have no single English equivalent; 'dispassion' and 'non-attachment' are approximate.
